title_en: How David Mount became employee #2 (for the second time) at 10x Science
desc_en: A veteran engineer finds his next act helping scientists discover cures, one amino acid at a time, at YC W26 startup 10x Science.

title_en: How Max Friedlander became founding operations at Petrarch
desc_en: A math major who turned down safe internships to lead high-stakes deals at a YC S26 startup supplying data for frontier AI labs.

title_en: How Harsh Vardhan Goenka became founding engineer #1 at Kalpa Labs
desc_en: From ICPC World Finals to competitive programming clubs to building generalist audio models as the first engineer at a YC startup.

title_en: Can AI data centers be mass-produced like cars? This startup aims to find out
desc_en: Runware is building a factory to turn out prefabricated AI data centers on an assembly line. The real test will be whether it can deliver at that scale.

desc_en: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.

title_en: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy
desc_en: Mintive was founded by two engineers who have been working on AI for decades through Google Brain and Coursera. It's platform promises to help IT easily control enterprise agents.

title_en: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
desc_en: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

title_en: 7 days until TechCrunch Founder Summit: Save up to $100 on your pass before doors open
desc_en: In just 7 days, TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston’s SoWa Power Station on November 4. Your chance to save up to $100 on tickets is running out, and the opportunity to learn and connect directly with experienced founders, investors, and startup leaders is almost here.

title_zh: Monday.com CEO谈SaaS是否已死：一切是否都将被Vibe Coding取代
title_en: Monday.com CEO on Is SaaS Dead: Will Everything Be Vibe Coded | Will Systems of Record Become Valueless Databases in an Agentic World | Will LLMs Own the Value in the Application Layer with Eran Zinman
speaker: Eran Zinman
desc_zh: Monday.com联合创始人兼CEO Eran Zinman与Harry Stebbings深入讨论了SaaS行业面临的六大威胁。Monday拥有13亿美元ARR，但市值仅38亿美元，较IPO以来下跌超60%。讨论了vibe coding的影响、AI代理是否会将Monday和Salesforce变成数据库、以及Monday用AI代理替代100名SDR并将回调时间从24小时缩短到3分钟的实践。
desc_en: Monday.com co-founder and CEO Eran Zinman joins Harry Stebbings to discuss six major threats facing Monday's business. With $1.3B ARR but valued at just $3.8B (60%+ drop since IPO), topics include the impact of vibe coding, whether AI agents will reduce SaaS platforms to databases, and how Monday replaced 100 SDRs with AI agents cutting callback times from 24 hours to 3 minutes.

title_zh: Applied Intuition的产品市场契合之路——150亿美元创始人的制胜公式
title_en: Applied Intuition's Path to Product-Market Fit — The $15B Founder's Formula for a Winning Company
speaker: Qasar Younis
desc_zh: Applied Intuition联合创始人兼CEO Qasar Younis分享了他建立公司的创始公式：先选联合创始人、再选市场、最后选想法。Applied Intuition估值150亿美元，客户包括全球前20大汽车制造商中的18家，正在引领物理AI革命——从潜水艇到汽车再到战斗机的智能部署。
desc_en: Applied Intuition co-founder and CEO Qasar Younis shares his founding formula: choose a co-founder, then a market, then an idea — in that order. Applied Intuition is worth $15B, counts 18 of the top 20 global automakers as customers, and is leading the physical AI revolution deploying intelligence in machines from submersibles to cars to fighter jets.

title_zh: Kalshi的10亿美元融资、与Polymarket的竞争、以及取代传统媒体之战
title_en: Tarek Mansour on Kalshi's $1BN Raise, the Polymarket Feud, and the Battle to Replace Traditional Media
speaker: Tarek Mansour
desc_zh: Kalshi联合创始人兼CEO Tarek Mansour与Harry Stebbings讨论了Kalshi以110亿美元估值完成10亿美元融资，累计融资15.9亿美元。投资方包括Sequoia、a16z、General Catalyst等。还讨论了与CNN和CNBC的独家合作、与Polymarket的竞争关系、以及预测市场的未来。
desc_en: Kalshi co-founder and CEO Tarek Mansour joins Harry Stebbings to discuss Kalshi's $1B raise at an $11B valuation, bringing total funding to $1.59B from Sequoia, a16z, General Catalyst, IVP, and Meritech. Topics include exclusive partnerships with CNN and CNBC, the fierce rivalry with Polymarket, and the future of prediction markets.

title_zh: “我听过最蠢的想法”到1亿美元ARR：Gamma的崛起之路
title_en: "Dumbest idea I've heard" to $100M ARR: Inside the rise of Gamma | Grant Lee (co-founder)
speaker: Grant Lee
desc_zh: Gamma联合创始人Grant Lee讲述了这个AI驱动的演示工具如何在仅约50人的精简团队下，两年多内达到1亿美元ARR，估值超过20亿美元。曾有投资人称这是"最蠢的想法"，但Gamma在大部分历史中一直保持盈利，几乎未进行大规模融资。
desc_en: Gamma co-founder Grant Lee tells the story of how the AI-powered presentation tool reached $100M ARR in just over two years with a lean team of about 50 people, achieving a valuation over $2 billion. Despite an investor calling it 'the dumbest idea he'd ever heard,' Gamma has been profitable for most of its history without raising significant funding.

title_zh: 如何活在所有人的未来：与Shopify CEO Tobi Lutke对话
title_en: How to Live in Everyone Else's Future (with Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke)
speaker: Tobi Lütke
desc_zh: Shopify创始人兼CEO Tobi Lütke与Acquired主持人进行了一次深入的哲学性对话。讨论了他在AI时代如何度过每一天、AI在哲学层面解锁了什么、以及他作为CEO经历Shopify高峰和模因股时代的反思。Shopify目前市值近2000亿美元，年收入约100亿美元。
desc_en: Shopify founder and CEO Tobi Lütke joins Acquired hosts Ben Gilbert and David Rosenthal for a philosophical deep-dive. Topics include how he spends his time with AI throughout the day, what AI unlocks philosophically, and reflections as a CEO through Shopify's highs and meme-stock era. Shopify is now worth nearly $200 billion with about $10 billion in annual revenue.

title_zh: Cursor的崛起：工程师离不开的3亿美元ARR AI工具
title_en: The rise of Cursor: The $300M ARR AI tool that engineers can't stop using | Michael Truell (co-founder and CEO)
speaker: Michael Truell
desc_zh: Cursor联合创始人兼CEO Michael Truell讲述了这款全球增长最快的AI代码编辑器如何在两年内达到3亿美元ARR。讨论了从机械工程工具到编程的早期转型、定制AI模型的策略、以及未来编程将从传统代码转向自然语言的愿景。
desc_en: Cursor co-founder and CEO Michael Truell discusses how the world's fastest-growing AI code editor reached $300M ARR in just two years. Topics include the early pivot from mechanical engineering tools to programming, the strategy behind custom AI models for coding tasks, and the vision for a future where programming shifts from traditional code to natural language.

title_zh: 一位创业CEO如何在5年内度过17,784个小时
title_en: How I Spent 17,784 Hours in 5 Years as a Startup Founder
speaker: Sam Corcos
desc_zh: Levels联合创始人兼CEO Sam Corcos详细分享了他五年创业期间每一分钟的时间分配，以及从早期阶段到规模化过程中的变化与反思。关键洞察包括：当每一分钟都被记录时，就没有自欺的空间。他还讨论了在规模化阶段远离代码库的教训，以及如何将组织精简回直接向他汇报的精干工程团队。
desc_en: Levels co-founder and CEO Sam Corcos shares a detailed breakdown of exactly how he spent 17,784 hours over 5 years building the company, with reflections on changes from early-stage to scale-up. Key insight: when every minute is accounted for, there's no room for self-deception. He also discusses the lesson of stepping away from the codebase during scaling and how he restructured back to a lean engineering team.

title_zh: 打造Lovable：15人团队60天内实现1000万美元ARR
title_en: Building Lovable: $10M ARR in 60 days with 15 people | Anton Osika (co-founder and CEO)
speaker: Anton Osika
desc_zh: Lovable联合创始人兼CEO Anton Osika讲述了这款AI驱动的无代码产品构建工具如何在前四周达到400万美元ARR，两个月内达到1000万美元ARR，仅靠15人团队，成为欧洲历史上增长最快的初创公司。
desc_en: Lovable co-founder and CEO Anton Osika discusses how the AI-powered tool that turns descriptions into working products hit $4M ARR in its first four weeks and $10M ARR in two months with just 15 people, making it Europe's fastest-growing startup ever.
